## Homework 2

- Read: Lange, J., Freyer, N., Musfeld, P., Schönbrodt, F., & Leising, D. (2025). A checklist for incentivizing and facilitating good theory building. *Zeitschrift Für Psychologie*, 2151-2604/a000604. [https://doi.org/10.1027/2151-2604/a000604](https://doi.org/10.1027/2151-2604/a000604)
- Also read the [checklist itself](https://osf.io/preprints/psyarxiv/e7tdc_v2)

Answer the following guiding questions:
 
1. Name the three immutable guiding principles of the checklist
<!-- First, all the basic elements of a theory should be defined and described as precisely as possible. 
Second, any steps toward formalization should be rewarded.
Third, the theory should allow researchers to derive and conduct informative evaluations of a theory via simulations and/or empirical studies -->

2. According to the introduction section of the checklist: What are the differences between a "theory" and a "formal model"?
<!-- In our terminology, a theory is always expressed in verbal form (i.e., in the natural language). Theories may be translated into formal models, that is, their elements may be expressed in the form of logical propositions, mathematical equations, or algorithms such as agent-based models -->

3. Name the two ways of evaluating a theory.
<!-- Theories may be evaluated via simulations and/or via empirical studies -->

**Deliverable**: Submit answers to the guiding questions as a plain text or markdown file to the course's [Homework Repository]({{< var homework_repo >}}), subfolder `04-Quality_checklist`.
